# OpenBB

> OpenBB is building an AI-powered research and analytics workspace for finance.

OpenBB provides a collaborative, fully customizable investment research platform that bridges proprietary data with AI. Investment teams use OpenBB Workspace to build AI-powered analytics applications securely and on their own terms.

## Products

- [OpenBB Workspace](https://openbb.co/products/workspace): Enterprise UI for data visualization and AI-powered analysis. Integrates public, proprietary and licensed data in one interface.
- [Open Data Platform (ODP)](https://openbb.co/products/odp): Open-source toolset for standardized data integrations that analysts consume through multiple interfaces.
- [OpenBB on Snowflake](https://openbb.co/products/snowflake): Native app on Snowflake Marketplace for in-platform analytics.

## Use Cases

- [Buy-Side](https://openbb.co/buy-side): Consolidate fragmented legacy tools into one secure workspace for analysts, PMs and investment teams.
- [AI Vendors](https://openbb.co/ai-vendor): Integrate AI agents into OpenBB Workspace with MCP or API. Focus on intelligence while OpenBB handles deployment and security.

## Key Features

- Data agnostic: connect Snowflake, FactSet, internal warehouses, alternative data
- AI-ready: plug in custom or third-party AI agents
- Enterprise security: SOC 2 Type II, SSO, RBAC, on-prem/VPC deployment
- Collaborative: shared dashboards, role-based access, centralized data
